# SpaceAutoBattler — LLM Navigation Guide

Deterministic 3D space auto-battler. This file orients contributors and LLMs to the canonical sources, configs, tests, and rules — updated for the 2025 rewrite.

Core rules (short):
- Edit only TypeScript in `src/`. Never modify generated `dist/` files.
- All runtime state lives on `GameState` (see `src/types/index.ts`). No module-level mutable state.
- Preserve determinism in simulation paths. Use the seeded RNG in `src/utils/rng.ts`.
- Prefer config/data in `src/game/*.ts` and `src/config/*.ts` over hard-coded values when tuning.
- Always run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` before committing.

## Source map (what to edit)

- `src/main.tsx` — App entry. Applies GLTF loader patch, mounts `<App/>`.
- `src/App.tsx` — App shell. Wires `GameProvider`, `<Battlefield/>`, `<Hud/>`, `<Controls/>`.
- `src/components/` — React Three Fiber scene objects and UI.
  - `Battlefield.tsx` — Creates Canvas, lights, Grid, hooks up systems via `useFrame`.
  - `Ship.tsx` / `Projectile.tsx` — Visuals and transform sync. Shields use material registry.
  - `Hud.tsx` / `Controls.tsx` — Heads-up display and simulation controls (pause, speed, spawn).
- `src/game/` — Simulation state and systems (miniplex ECS + Rapier3D on main thread).
  - `state.ts` — `createGameState`, entity lifecycle, initial fleets, spawn helpers.
  - `systems.ts` — Per-frame update: ship AI (nearest-target), movement, projectiles, damage, ripples.
  - `ships.ts` — Ship blueprints/stats and `spawnShip` (creates Rapier bodies/colliders).
  - `config.ts` — World constants (size, fog/camera defaults), clamp helper.
  - `context.tsx` — React provider exposing `GameState`; E2E-only window hooks.
  - `uiStore.ts` — UI state via Zustand (paused, timeScale).
- `src/renderer/materialRegistry.tsx` — Material registry with built-in shield (hex/transmission), bullet, explosion materials.
- `src/config/renderer.ts` — Per-hull shield visual settings and helpers.
- `src/assets/` — GLTF URL mappings and SVGs.
- `src/utils/` — Utilities: deterministic RNG; GLTFLoader patch.
- `src/types/` — Canonical types including `GameState`, `GameEntity`, and components.

Notes:
- This rewrite runs Rapier on the main thread (stepped inside R3F `useFrame`), not a worker.
- Assets are cached via drei/useGLTF; there is no `assetPool` on `GameState` in this version.

## Tests & validation

- Unit tests: `test/vitest/` (Vitest; happy-dom env).
- E2E: `test/playwright/e2e.spec.ts` with `playwright.config.cjs`.
- Useful scripts (see `package.json`):
  - `npm run typecheck` — TypeScript check.
  - `npm test` — Vitest (unit).
  - `npm run test:playwright` or `npm run test:e2e` — Playwright E2E.
  - `npm run build` / `npm run build:dev` — Webpack builds.
  - `npm run start` — Webpack dev server; `npm run serve` to serve `dist/`.

## Assets & configuration

- Visuals: `src/config/renderer.ts` (shield visuals per hull).
- Ship stats & spawn: `src/game/ships.ts`, `src/game/state.ts`.
- GLTFs: `src/assets/gltf/*.glb` (imported via asset/resource, referenced from `src/assets/ships.ts`).
- SVGs: `src/assets/svg/*.svg`.

## Docs & specs

- `AGENTS.md` — Contributor and agent rules (kept in sync with this guide).
- `docs/` — Design notes (renderer, balance, data flow).
- `spec/` — Structure overview and UI docs.

## Memory (project context)

- `memory/activeContext.md` — Current focus and decisions.
- `memory/_index.md` — Memory index and tasks.

## Quick contributor reminders

- Keep all mutable runtime state on `GameState`.
- Maintain determinism in `src/game/systems.ts` (use seeded RNG if randomness is required).
- Dispose Three.js resources when adding new materials/geometries. Drei/useGLTF caches models.
- When changing hull stats or visuals, update `src/game/ships.ts` and/or `src/config/renderer.ts` and add/adjust tests if relevant.
